topic: 5 money wins you can do this weekend
hook: 5 money wins you can do this weekend.

slides.title: 1. Open a HYSA
slides.body: Move idle cash to ~4%. ~$400/yr on $10k for doing nothing.

slides.title: 2. Cancel 2 subscriptions
slides.body: Find them in your bank app. Most people save $30-60/month.

slides.title: 3. Automate one transfer
slides.body: Set $50/week to savings on payday. Done forever.

slides.title: 4. Call one bill
slides.body: Internet, phone or insurance. Ask for a better rate.

slides.title: 5. List 3 things to sell
slides.body: Seed your first $1,000 emergency fund this weekend.

slides.title: Save this
slides.body: Do one today. Follow for a money win every week.

caption:
5 money wins you can knock out this weekend — each under 20 min. ✅

HYSA, cancel 2 subs, automate a transfer, call a bill, list 3 things to sell.

Save this and do at least one.
